name: 乗継と所要時間と往復の時間をまとめる絞り込み
prompt:
Create one polished, faithful Japanese mobile filter-sheet UI component for catalog ID LH01-0134, “乗継と所要時間と往復の時間をまとめる絞り込み”. Use the original Booking.com screen and its exact filter-sheet crop as authority for component boundaries, section order, control anatomy, alignments, row spacing, dividers, radio placement, slider position, tabs, and bottom action. Use the existing Japanese mock as the authority for translated copy, example price, result count, and current interaction state. Use the approved gradient-operation reference only for the restrained forest-green action treatment; do not copy its icons, colored circles, or labels.

Render a single white, portrait filter sheet close to 390x798 proportion, without phone frame, status bar, underlying page, Mobbin footer, or screenshot chrome. Preserve the complete hierarchy and order:
1. A slim top row with a quiet close X at left and green “すべて解除” text at right.
2. Bold title “条件で絞り込む”.
3. Section heading “乗り継ぎ回数”, followed by three compact radio rows. Keep all three radios empty and right-aligned. Each row contains the exact primary and secondary copy:
“直行便のみ” / “¥ 15,000から”
“1回まで” / “¥ 15,000から”
“2回まで” / “¥ 15,000から”
4. A fine neutral divider, then section heading “所要時間”. Under it show “移動時間の上限（時間）” and “27時間”. Add one horizontal range slider with a green track and round thumb at the far right to show its current maximum.
5. A fine neutral divider, then section heading “出発時間”. Add two equal horizontal tabs, “往路” selected and “復路” inactive, with a clear green selected underline and thin neutral baseline. Below, show “ロサンゼルス発”.
6. At the bottom, one prominent green action button reading exactly “70件の検索結果を表示”.

Keep the original relative spacing and compact grouping. Use Meiryo, with section headings Bold 20/28 px, primary body Regular 14/24 px, supporting price text Regular 12/16 px, and 0 tracking. Use dark ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, utility controls #526173, and Lighthouse forest green #1F6444. Keep the white #FFFFFF surface and thin pale neutral separators. The primary action may use a smooth, restrained gradient from #174C36 through #1F6444 to #2D8F5E; keep all radio states unselected and use green for the slider and selected outbound tab. Keep the layout clean, legible, and dense enough to fit the full component. Do not add filters, prices, claims, icons besides the close X and radio controls, or explanatory copy.
reviewNotes: Agent visual review: the overall filter sheet, radio states, maximum slider, outbound-selected tabs, origin row, green palette and CTA are correct. Needs correction because the duration label contains spaces around the full-width parentheses. Required copy is exactly 移動時間の上限（時間）. Preserve this candidate and make only that text correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
